legend: Friday is Polycarpus' favourite day of the week. Not because it is followed by the weekend, but because the lessons on Friday are 2 IT lessons, 2 math lessons and 2 literature lessons. Of course, Polycarpus has prepared to all of them, unlike his buddy Innocentius. Innocentius spent all evening playing his favourite game Fur2 and didn't have enough time to do the literature task. As Innocentius didn't want to get an F, he decided to do the task and read the book called "Storm and Calm" during the IT and Math lessons (he never used to have problems with these subjects). When the IT teacher Mr. Watkins saw this, he decided to give Innocentius another task so that the boy concentrated more on the lesson and less — on the staff that has nothing to do with IT.

Mr. Watkins said that a palindrome is a string that can be read the same way in either direction, from the left to the right and from the right to the left. A concatenation of strings a, b is a string ab that results from consecutive adding of string b to string a. Of course, Innocentius knew it all but the task was much harder than he could have imagined. Mr. Watkins asked change in the "Storm and Calm" the minimum number of characters so that the text of the book would also be a concatenation of no more than k palindromes. Innocentius can't complete the task and therefore asks you to help him.
input: The first input line contains a non-empty string s which is the text of "Storm and Calm" (without spaces). The length of the string s does not exceed 500 characters. String s consists of uppercase and lowercase Latin letters. The second line contains a single number k (1 ≤ k ≤ |s|, where |s| represents the length of the string s).
output: Print on the first line the minimum number of changes that Innocentius will have to make. Print on the second line the string consisting of no more than k palindromes. Each palindrome should be non-empty and consist of uppercase and lowercase Latin letters. Use the character "+" (ASCII-code 43) to separate consecutive palindromes. If there exist several solutions, print any of them.
The letters' case does matter, that is an uppercase letter is not considered equivalent to the corresponding lowercase letter.

legend.ai: 星期五是 Polycarpus 最喜欢的日子。并不是因为星期五之后就是周末，而是因为星期五有 2 节信息技术课、2 节数学课和 2 节文学课。当然，Polycarpus 为所有课程都做好了准备，不像他的朋友 Innocentius。Innocentius 整晚都在玩他最喜欢的游戏 Fur2，因此没有足够的时间完成文学作业。由于 Innocentius 不想拿到 F，他决定完成作业，并在信息技术课和数学课上阅读一本名为《风暴与平静》的书（他从来不会在这些科目上遇到问题）。信息技术老师 Watkins 先生看到这一幕后，决定再给 Innocentius 布置一项任务，让这个男孩更加专注于课堂，而少关注与信息技术毫无关系的事情。

Watkins先生说，回文串是一种从左到右和从右到左读起来都相同的字符串。字符串 a、b 的拼接是一个字符串 ab，它由将字符串 b 接在字符串 a 后面得到。当然，Innocentius 对此早已知晓，但任务比他想象的要困难得多。Watkins先生要求在《风暴与平静》中修改最少数量的字符，使得这本书的文本也成为不超过 k 个回文串的拼接。Innocentius 无法完成这项任务，因此请求你帮助他。

input.ai: 输入的第一行包含一个非空字符串 s，它是《风暴与平静》的文本（不含空格）。字符串 s 的长度不超过 500。字符串 s 由大写和小写拉丁字母组成。第二行包含一个整数 k（1 ≤ k ≤ |s|，其中 |s| 表示字符串 s 的长度）。

output.ai: 第一行输出 Innocentius 必须进行的最少修改次数。第二行输出一个由不超过 k 个回文串组成的字符串。每个回文串都必须非空，且由大写和小写拉丁字母组成。使用字符“+”（ASCII 码为 43）分隔相邻的回文串。如果存在多个解，输出任意一个即可。
字母的大小写有区别，也就是说，大写字母不被视为与对应的小写字母等价。
